effect.name: GM Curve
effect.desc: Bends the layer like a sheet of paper. The layer is treated as a real cylindrical surface: the coordinate along the bend axis is mapped through an arc, a perspective divide is applied so the far side genuinely foreshortens, and the perpendicular axis scales with it - which is why the result reads as a curved object instead of as a stretched picture. Six presets cover bowing inward, bowing outward, a flat arc, a full cylinder, an S-curve that reverses across the middle and a page curl. Bend amount, axis, curvature profile, perspective, anchor, twist, a directional sheen and clamp/mirror/wrap sampling are all separate.
